host.description: Bare compute name (e.g. "bridge", not "bridge-01") of the vm that hosts this service.

pki.description: Name of the two-tier (mesh) PKI in pki.enc.yaml this service is a leaf member of. Its per-scope intermediate must exist for the service's scope (global service -> global; regional service -> every region).

reload.description: Optional ExecReload command the service uses to apply a renewed mesh leaf without downtime (e.g. "/bin/kill -HUP $MAINPID" or "nginx -s reload"). When set, the renewal timer reloads the unit; when absent, it restarts.

ingress.description: typed inbound routes realized on the host's nginx. Each entry binds a public listen port; tls-termination entries may share a port (SNI demux), a forward port is single-service-exclusive.

type.description: tls-termination: nginx terminates ACME TLS for the service's SNIs and reverse-proxies to target. forward: nginx stream-forwards the raw L4 connection to target with the PROXY protocol; the backend owns its TLS.

listen.description: public port nginx accepts traffic on (required; no default; must differ from target)

target.description: loopback port the service listens on; nginx reverse-proxies/forwards to 127.0.0.1:target (required; must differ from listen). A raw public port with no proxy belongs on the compute's firewall.inbound, not here.

vanity.description: extra public FQDNs (beyond the auto-derived <svc>.svc name) a tls-termination entry serves. A bare token is env+region-scoped; a value with a dot or a {BASE_DOMAIN}/{ENV}/{REGION_SLUG} placeholder is a literal FQDN. Valid only on tls-termination (forward has no SNI).
